name: ItemTemplateQueryInput
description: Represents a query against item templates.

inputFields.name: contextItemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the context item. If provided the template query will try to lookup field sources.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the item database.

inputFields.name: path
inputFields.description: The path of the item template.

inputFields.name: templateId
inputFields.description: The ID of the item template. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.
